    (hC : Plus.FormPlus [] C)
    (hp : Plus.HasPlus [] p C) (hq : Plus.HasPlus [] q C)
    (sp : Scoped 0 p) (sq : Scoped 0 q) :
    Plus.FormPlus [] (.identity C p q) ∧
    ((∃ r, Plus.HasPlus [] r (.identity C p q)) ↔
      Plus.HasPlus [] (.atom .i) (.identity C p q)) ∧
    (Plus.HasPlus [] (.atom .i) (.identity C p q) ↔
      Conv (eval p zeroEnv) (eval q zeroEnv))
